name: Îles-de-Boucherville National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on the Île-Sainte-Marguerite trail, its picnic areas and the RV area, but not in boats.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on the Île-Sainte-Marguerite trail, its picnic areas and the RV area, but not in boats.

excerpts.quote: Les chiens sont admis dans l'Espace VR.
Notez que les chiens ne sont pas admis sur les embarcations en location et les embarcations personnelles, sauf pour les chiens-guides.

dogRules.text: Trail (summer and winter): Île-Sainte-Marguerite multi-use trail and its picnic areas.
No dogs in rented or personal boats.
